name: Sousha Yui
source:
A refined girl with long, straight black hair who attends a prestigious private academy.

Troubled by the gap between the image others have of her and the person she truly wants to be, she harbors loneliness deep within her heart.
Her fate begins to change dramatically when she hears a mysterious voice one day.

Guided by that voice, she is forced to confront the "true self" that she has been avoiding until now.
